kind: bug / PyNative / Tensor method wrapper call
title: Tensor.eigvals() fails in PyNative mode because the wrapper calls ops.eigvals without the tensor
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local Tensor.eigvals is present and its docstring refers to mindspore.ops.eigvals.
A public Tensor.eigvals API page from the MindSpore 2.7.2 documentation documents Tensor.eigvals() as referring to mindspore.ops.eigvals().
The MindSpore 2.9 ops index documents ops.eigvals as supporting Ascend and CPU.
The local Graph standard method correctly routes Tensor.eigvals to F.eigvals(x).
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the Tensor method raises before computing any eigenvalues in PyNative mode.
Not an unsupported CPU eigvals kernel issue: ops.eigvals(x) works in PyNative and Graph modes, and Tensor.eigvals() works in Graph mode.
The failure is localized to the PyNative Tensor wrapper calling tensor_operator_registry.get('eigvals')() before passing self.
